notes.user_brief: Yann Tiersen, Comptine d'un autre ete : l'apres-midi (Live). Solo piano, E minor. Left hand: a steady broken-chord ostinato cycling Em - G - Bm - D, never stops, hardly changes. Right hand: a naive stepwise melody, restated in octaves, then thickened. Additive form, no modulation, no bridge: grows by layering density and volume over the same loop; the climax is texture (rapid figuration over the same chords), then thins back to the bare opening. Live: freer tempo (rubato in the opening, the climax pushed faster), harder, more percussive attack, more room.
notes.tool_caveat: trackmap locked 215 BPM onto the left hand's broken-chord notes (coherence 0.088, dp_residual 86 ms, tonic D major conf 0.013 vs the truth E minor): the beat list is the ARPEGGIO lattice, not the felt pulse. No percussion at all on this track - the first such test track. Felt pulse to be settled by ear with clicktrack.py --every=2 / --every=4 (107.7 / 53.8 BPM).
